notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Stability, Smaller Bugfixes and German Text Version
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

we worked hard to bring you our first bigger Patch Version 1.0.2 

While it still won't be the end of our road this version packs some smaller changes:

- Small restructure of the Tutorial
- Fixed Physics Glitches
- and a complete German Text Version. 

We hope you enjoy these Changes.

1.0.3 will probably arrive later this year in late April because we can only work on the game in our free time. But it will bring some fixes and additions to the soundscape.

Until then we hope you have a great time,

Valerie

notes.title: The Release of Belonging
notes.notes:
[b]Finally![/b]

Belonging celebrates the release of version 1.0 today, the journey to this point has been very rocky and we had a decision to make. Either the game is finished or it goes into development hell. With the risk that it might never be finished. We decided to finish the game. 

The result is: a good adventure game created with profound background knowledge and a few surprises for the players. We sincerely hope you enjoy exploring the inner workings of the cult!

But we are far from finished. Bug fixes and content patches are planned for the near future.

These include in the first 3 months after release:

- Fixes for minor problems with the engine
- Fixes for UI elements
- Fixes for sound
- Content patches with sound updates
- German localization

and maybe even more. 


Thank you for your support and for taking this journey with us.

[strike]Alex [/strike] Valerie, Lead Designerin

notes.title: Our discord community is online! Join us!
notes.notes:
As of yesterday you can join our discord community.

The link is[url=https://discord.gg/yv7D8TGEQz] right here[/url]!

We want to create a space where we can:
- Chat about dev stuff
- Share our thoughts about the topics of the game
- Gather your Feedback
- Share exclusive previews of the game
- Have development streams
- [i]Announce Public Beta Tests[/i]

and most importantly where we can get your input for a community project that we want to be part of Belonging called the "Cult Story Gallery". A mode in the game where we want to exhibit annonymous real life stories of moments where our community encountered cults. We'd love to have your input on that.

notes.title: Play Belonging at PAX West!
notes.notes:
Well Gamescom wasn't enough! We travelled across the big pond to be able to show the Demo of Belonging at PAX West.

Drop by our booth on Level 0 - Booth 3233 and play the game for yourself!

notes.title: Tell us your story about cults!
notes.notes:
Have you encountered cult like ideologies in your life? It's more likely than you think.

With Belonging we want to start a conversation how we as a society can better deal with the emergence of cults in our social environment and how we can protect those closest to us. The solidarity we can find when sharing our lived experiences is very inspiring!

If you have a story to share or have an interesting observation you made about cult-like organizations we'd love to chat with you! 

Comment below so we can start a conversation.
